reply_text:
*One merge blocker* in `leaderboard-sort` vs `main`:

*High — `src/rank.js:3`: sorting silently rounds large scores.*
`b.score - a.score` coerces decimal strings to JavaScript Numbers, violating the precision requirement in `README.md:5`. Verified that input scores `9007199254740992`, then `9007199254740993` leave the lower score ranked first; `topN(entries, 1)` consequently returns the wrong winner.

*Recommended fix:* use the existing exact comparator: `.sort((a, b) => compareScore(b.score, a.score))`. Add a regression test with those adjacent scores; `test/rank.test.js` currently covers only small values.

All 3 existing tests pass. No other findings. No code changed.
